Friday Java Ride (Beach Cities Cycling Club)

Redondo Beach, CA · South Bay · Road

Friday Java Ride (Beach Cities Cycling Club) is a road group ride in Redondo Beach, CA. It rolls every Friday at 9:00 am from Redondo Beach Pier, pedestrian area south of Captain Kidd's.

About the Friday Java Ride (Beach Cities Cycling Club) group ride

An easy, flat coffee ride to a cafe or bakery in the South Bay or Westside. The club calls it its most social ride and a good first ride for beginners or people getting back into it. The club has a no-drop policy on all rides and runs 13 activities a week at four levels, most from the Redondo pier.
